facts.fact: 中文：安格尔顿1954至1974年担任中情局反间谍部门主管。
facts.anchor: his job as Chief of CIA’s Counterintelligence Staff from 1954 to 1974

facts.fact: 中文：从1949年起，他每个工作日12:30离开中情局，去五月花酒店旁的哈维餐厅喝四杯马提尼的午餐。
facts.anchor: from 1949 onward, he drove away from CIA at 12:30 p.m. every weekday and went straight on over to Harvey’s Restaurant in Washington, D.C., next to the Mayflower Hotel, for a four-martini lunch.

facts.fact: 中文：莫斯科中心不少于2187人因这场渗透行动获得奖章。
facts.anchor: no fewer than 2,187 guys over there at Moscow Center got medals

facts.fact: 中文：1949至1951年间，他每个工作日都和剑桥间谍金·菲尔比一起吃午饭喝酒。
facts.anchor: Jim Angleton went off to drink lunch with each and every weekday from 1949 to 1951

facts.fact: 中文：菲尔比1934年2月24日秘密迎娶奥地利共产党人爱丽丝·“莉齐”·弗里德曼。
facts.anchor: Philby’s secret February 24th, 1934, nuptials to Austrian Communist Alice “Litzi” Friedmann

facts.fact: 中文：安格尔顿二战前从耶鲁学院低分毕业，先加入OSS，后加入中情局。
facts.anchor: graduated with bad grades from Yale College just prior to World War II, joined OSS, joined CIA

facts.fact: 中文：菲尔比听安格尔顿倾诉，把内容记下后转报莫斯科中心。
facts.anchor: Philby would listen, and then listen some more, his prodigious memory squirreling these fireside chats away for later transmission to Moscow Center.

facts.fact: 中文：安格尔顿在被问及1963年11月22日星期五在达拉斯枪杀肯尼迪总统的人时始终回避。
facts.anchor: who took out President John F. Kennedy in Dallas, Texas, on Friday, November 22nd, 1963
